sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Hexa Merge's core gameplay mechanic revolves around merging hexagonal blocks of the same color. The game starts with a grid of six blocks, and your goal is to merge these blocks to create a chain reaction of points and bonuses. To merge blocks, you can drag and drop them into empty tiles or swap them with other blocks using the tap-to-swap feature.

As you progress through levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, with new blocks and obstacles introduced to the grid. The game also features power-ups and bonuses that can be unlocked by merging blocks in a specific way. For example, merging three blocks of the same color in a row creates a power-up that can be used to clear a column or row of blocks.

One of the most unique features of Hexa Merge is its ability to combine blocks of different colors. By merging blocks of different colors, you can create a new block with a color that is not present in the grid. This feature adds a new layer of strategy to the game, as you need to think ahead and plan your moves carefully to create the right combinations.

Overall, Hexa Merge's core gameplay mechanic is engaging, challenging, and rewarding. The game's ability to balance simplicity and complexity makes it an excellent choice for players of all ages and skill levels.
